answer.title: Automated Invoice Creation on Job Completion
answer.trigger: A job is marked as complete in the jobs system.
steps: Detect when a job status changes to complete in the jobs system.
Extract job details, customer information, and signed job sheet data.
Draft a new invoice with the correct billing details in the accounts system.
Route the drafted invoice to Emma for review and approval.
answer.ai_help: Extracting job details from the completed job sheet to automatically populate the correct line items and amounts in the invoice.
answer.human_approval: Emma must review and approve the draft invoice before it is finalized and sent to the customer.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation miscalculates or bills the wrong amount, it could result in financial errors and customer disputes.
